FN-0HVO6C-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 132
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Ivan Smith
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/14/2023
House Bill 132 as introduced would exclude medical cannabis from the producer value added
sales tax exemption. As no such products have been sold in the state to date, this bill would not
directly affect state or local funding.
